attrs.quote: This release includes several breaking changes aimed at future-proofing OSV-Scanner.
attrs.scope: the 30 most recent releases, v1.8.4 to v2.7.0
attrs.note: Only v2.0.0 (2025-03-17) is flagged breaking, with its pre-releases v2.0.0-rc1 and -beta1; v1.9.1 only announces V2. None from v2.0.1 to v2.7.0 mentions breaking.
